items.source: Configures the include or exclude using a user-provided property in the form groupId:artifactId or groupId:artifactId:classifier.
items.translation: 使用用户提供的属性配置包含或排除，格式为 groupId:artifactId 或 groupId:artifactId:classifier。

items.source: A model for a dependency to include or exclude.
items.translation: 用于包含或排除依赖项的模型。
